title: The authorize redirect carries code and state, and POST /api/1.0/token exchanges the code for the seven documented fields

source.note: The page documents the authorize URL (response_type, client_id, redirect_uri, state, scope), the five exchange parameters (code, client_id, client_secret, grant_type, redirect_uri) sent form-encoded, and the response's fields: access_token, token_type Bearer, expires (a Unix timestamp), expires_in (seconds), refresh_token, domain_prefix, scope. The token endpoint is NOT in api-2026-07.yaml, which is why the declaration excuses it. The code value below is not documented -- it is the one this unit mints on a fresh unit, and it is stable because conformance C06 and C22 require the seeded scenario and its id streams to be deterministic across two units and two processes.
